_note: THE SINGLE SOURCE FOR EMAIL-CAPTURE COPY ON PUBLIC TOOL PAGES, keyed magnet -> language. A page opts in with `toolCapture: <magnet>` in its front matter — note the file is capture.json and NOT toolCapture.json, because Eleventy front matter overrides global data of the same name and a page setting `toolCapture` would shadow the whole file; partials/tool-capture.njk renders this and partials/strength-tool.njk adds a one-line nudge to the done overlay. The magnet key is sent verbatim to /api/tool-lead, where the workflow's Magnet registry node resolves it to a PDF and the email copy — so ADDING A MAGNET IS AN ENTRY HERE PLUS AN ENTRY THERE, and nothing else. Deliberately NOT in strengthUi.json: that file is engine chrome shared by 15 gated pages, and capture copy is neither engine-level nor gated. THE TEST FOR WHETHER A TOOL GETS A CAPTURE AT ALL (open-loops.md, September 8, 2026, the pace-converter decision): an email box belongs on a tool only when an artifact exists that CONTINUES THE JOB THE TOOL STARTED. The zones calculator qualifies; the pace converter does not and correctly has none. Do not add a key here just because a page is public.
